description: This file contains a suite of unit tests for Orleans activation and placement scenarios, including tests for grain movement, placement hints, and streaming behavior within a simulated clustered environment.

classes.name: DefaultToleranceTests
classes.description: Test class for scenario-based activation placement and movement in Orleans, utilizing various grains and testing their behavior under different scenarios.

classes.name: GrainBase
classes.description: Abstract base class for grains, providing a method to get its address.

classes.name: A
classes.description: A grain implementation for testing activation movement, with setup for different scenarios involving other grains.

classes.name: B
classes.description: A grain implementation used in testing, often acting as interaction points in the scenarios.

classes.name: C
classes.description: A grain implementation that can be moved or immovable, involved in placement and movement testing.

classes.name: CImmovable
classes.description: A special grain marked as immovable, used to test retention and placement constraints.

classes.name: D
classes.description: Another grain used in specific scenarios, representing a different placement or movement node.

classes.name: SP
classes.description: A stream-processing grain that acts as a pulling agent, used to test streaming placement behaviors.

classes.name: SR
classes.description: A stream subscriber grain, used to verify stream consumption and location after repartitioning.

classes.name: Fixture
classes.description: Test fixture setting up cluster configuration, silos, stream provider, and options for testing.

methods.name: FirstPing
methods.description: Initial ping setup for grains, assigning placement hints according to scenario.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Method for grains to perform a ping, simulating activity and triggering placement logic.

methods.name: GetAddress
methods.description: Fetches the current silo address hosting the grain.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Lifecycle method called upon grain activation, used to initialize streaming subscriptions.

methods.name: StreamPing
methods.description: Sends a message to a stream, used to verify stream location and behavior.

methods.name: GotStreamHit
methods.description: Checker method to see if a stream was hit by messages, used for placement verification.

methods.name: TriggerExchangeRequest
methods.description: Method to manually trigger the repartitioning process during tests.

methods.name: ConfigureTestCluster
methods.description: Sets up the cluster with specific options for reproducible test conditions.
